Name: HigherValueQuantityA
Expression:
VAR CategoryMedian= [medianCategory]
VAR HighvaluedRows =
    FILTER(
        VALUES('gold dim_products'[product_name]),
        [revenueperunit] > CategoryMedian
    ) 
RETURN  SUMX(HighvaluedRows,[ATotalQuantity])

    RETURN SUMX(highvalue,[BTotalQuantity])

Name: Dynamic Comparison Title
Expression:
VAR CountryA =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Country A'[country])

VAR CountryB =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Country B'[country])

VAR Category =
    SELECTEDVALUE('gold dim_products'[category])

RETURN
    CountryA
        & " vs "
        & CountryB
        & " - Higher- vs Lower-Value "
        & Category
        & " Product Quantity Share Mix"

Name: Product Bar Color
Expression:
VAR ProductRank =
    RANKX(
        ALLSELECTED('gold dim_products'[product_name]),
        [Total Revenue],
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    )

RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ProductRank = 1, "#4F6EF7",
        "#A5B8F8"
    )

Name: Country A Product Color
Expression:
VAR CurrentRevenue =
    [REVENUECNTRYA]

VAR HighestRevenue =
    MAXX(
        ALLSELECTED('gold dim_products'[product_name]),
        [REVENUECNTRYA]
    )

RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(CurrentRevenue)
            && CurrentRevenue = HighestRevenue,
        "#263E91",
        "#8294EA"
    )
